mainAirport.name: Perth Airport

cross runway (2,163 m, south-west to north-east)
new parallel runway (3,000 m, under construction; position approximate)
runways.placement: APPROXIMATE. Drawn parallel to 03/21, 2,000 m east of its centreline (MDP: 'situated on the eastern side of the airport estate, 2,000 metres from the existing main runway'), 3,000 m long. MDP Vol A s6 says the new runway is staggered south ('southern end ... approximately 1,030 metres further south than the existing main runway (03L/21R) northern threshold', to keep it south of Munday Swamp). Wording is ambiguous; placed with its northern end ~1,030 m south of the existing 21 threshold. Ends could be off by ~500 m along the runway line.

mainAirport.curfew: No curfew - Perth Airport operates 24 hours, with overnight 'red-eye' departures to the east coast and long-haul flights at night.
mainAirport.notes: Regular wide-bodies: Emirates and Qatar A380s, Qantas 787 non-stop to London/Paris/Rome, plus A330/777/787 from Asia and the Middle East. Also very busy early-morning FIFO (fly-in fly-out) mining charters (A320/737/Fokker 100/turboprops). Main runway ends: SkyVector (YPPH). New runway: construction commenced 2025-26 (Airservices says 2025, Perth Airport says March 2026), completion expected 2028 (Wikipedia says 2029). Airservices is designing the new flight paths.

otherAirports.name: Jandakot Airport
otherAirports.note: One of Australia's busiest airports by movements (~200,000+ a year, historically the busiest general-aviation field) - mostly light training aircraft flying repeated circuits all day, plus police/RFDS/firefighting aircraft and helicopters. Suburbs close by (Jandakot, Banjup, Leeming, Bull Creek, Atwell, Success, Canning Vale) hear frequent small-plane noise rather than jets.

otherAirports.name: RAAF Base Pearce
otherAirports.note: RAAF pilot training base at Bullsbrook, ~35 km north-east of the CBD: PC-21 turboprop trainers and Hawk 127 lead-in fighter jets (plus Singapore Air Force training). Loud but mostly weekday daytime; affects Bullsbrook and parts of Ellenbrook/Upper Swan.

future.label: After Perth's new parallel runway opens (2028)
future.explain: A second 3,000 m runway 2 km east of the main runway is under construction and due to finish in 2028, with new Airservices flight paths. Most suburbs see no change, but areas south-east (Forrestfield, High Wycombe, Wattle Grove, Maddington/Kenwick) and north-east (Maida Vale, Hazelmere, Midland side) are likely to get more or new overflights.

plans.name: Airport line
plans.about: Rail link from Bayswater to Redcliffe, Airport Central (T1/T2) and High Wycombe, mostly in twin tunnels under the airport.
plans.note: Coordinates from memory of station/road positions (web page fetches were rate-limited); approximate to a few hundred metres.

plans.name: Ellenbrook line (Morley-Ellenbrook)
plans.about: New 21 km line branching at Bayswater and running up the Tonkin Highway median to Morley, Noranda, Ballajura, Whiteman Park and Ellenbrook.
plans.note: Coordinates from memory of station/road positions (web page fetches were rate-limited); approximate to a few hundred metres.

plans.name: Thornlie-Cockburn line
plans.about: First east-west cross-suburban line, extending from Thornlie via Nicholson Road and Ranford Road stations to Cockburn Central on the Mandurah line.
plans.note: Coordinates from memory of station/road positions (web page fetches were rate-limited); approximate to a few hundred metres.

plans.name: Byford rail extension
plans.about: Armadale line extended 8 km south to a new Byford station, with the Armadale section rebuilt as elevated rail.
plans.note: Coordinates from memory of station/road positions (web page fetches were rate-limited); approximate to a few hundred metres.

plans.name: Yanchep rail extension
plans.about: Joondalup line extended 14.5 km north from Butler to new stations at Alkimos, Eglinton and Yanchep.
plans.note: Coordinates from memory of station/road positions (web page fetches were rate-limited); approximate to a few hundred metres.

plans.name: Tonkin Highway Extension (Thomas Rd to South Western Hwy)
plans.status: Under construction since mid-2025; completion late 2028 (Main Roads)
plans.about: Roughly $1 billion extension of Tonkin Highway south from Thomas Road to South Western Highway near Mundijong, with Thomas Road upgrades, serving Byford, Oakford and Mundijong growth areas.
plans.note: End points only, from memory; alignment not verified.

plans.name: Tonkin Gap
plans.status: Completed (lanes opened December 2023, officially complete August 2024)
plans.about: Widening of about 7 km of Tonkin Highway from Collier Road to Great Eastern Highway, built together with the Airport and Ellenbrook line rail works.
plans.note: Coordinates from memory of station/road positions (web page fetches were rate-limited); approximate to a few hundred metres.

plans.name: EastLink WA (Orange Route)
plans.status: Planning - no construction date for the new route
plans.about: Proposed new freight highway from Perth's north-east (Roe/Reid Highway, Middle Swan) up the Darling Scarp to Great Eastern Highway east of the hills, taking trucks off Great Eastern Highway through Midland and the hills.
plans.note: Concept only: rough end points, alignment not verified.
